title: School, a street quartet and kids playing piano in church
summary: Breaking windows at Lincoln School, singing spirituals on street corners, and taking over the church piano with a preacher's daughter.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: to the American flag...all that jazz. And we used to play ball in the back of the school, and it wasn't too big a yard so we hit the ball, and we'd break the window, and everybody would scatter. Jus' know the teacher gonna raise some sand 'n! "Who did that?" and tell us, "Go out in the alley and play with the ball. Don't play it in the schoolgrounds...gonna break out the windows." But we didn't pay no attention. We'd go right on back and do the same thing the next day.
We used to go out on a corner at night, sit around on the...in the park and sing. We had a quartet. We sing up a storm.
Remember any of those songs that you sang?

Oh, they was old spiritual songs we used to sing, and...uh...which we'd heard in church or heard on the wind-up Victrolas. We used to do all that kind of jazz. We had a lot of fun. We took our time in the daytime when we wasn't in school. We get out of school, we all hang out on the corner and watch the kids fight and act a fool, and there'd always be a big gang of them, always something went all wrong... kid be fightin' up and down the street. I never was a fighter, so I be the onlooker, and used to go back and forth to church. They would a had to go to church during the week. Mother took us to church...all the club meetings and to church we went. On Sunday we went, and the preacher had 'bout five or six children, and one of them was a piano player, a girl, so she used to get together in the daytime when we weren't in school. We'd go round there in church and play the piano. We be singing everything...

in the church...and the people say, "Get them bad kids out of here. They ain't...they don't know nothin' about the Lord...the devil gonna get 'em." So then we start in playin' hymns, and the girl start playin' a hymn...a church hymn. We sang. They thought that was outa sight. An'll now they gettin' around to doin' somethin' right...once in a chain.
